decisions.note: Japanese 祝宴の征服者 allows several natural treatments for 祝宴 and the title-like 征服者; no reviewed Vietnamese canonical wording exists.
Japanese title intentionally mixes kanji, ☆ and katakana; project lacks a stable rule here for preserving 'Wonder Doll' versus translating it.
Japanese 噴泉スピリット combines a scenario image with a loanword; several Vietnamese/romanized treatments are plausible, so defer.
Japanese 弾ける足取り has multiple natural Vietnamese renderings for both the energetic verb and gait phrase; no canonical mapping resolves them.
Japanese マジ爆上げっしょ！ is strongly character-voiced slang; do not invent a fixed Vietnamese catchphrase without reviewed voice treatment.
Japanese カーニバルボーナス is event-specific; project has no reviewed convention yet for preserving 'Carnival Bonus' versus translating the event title.
Skill ID 100431 is publicly verified with the Latin-script title Ding Dong Boo; preserve that source title exactly rather than reconstructing onomatopoeia from zh-CN.
Japanese ノイズキャンセリング can naturally become 'khử nhiễu', 'chống ồn' or a preserved English-style title; no project convention selects one.
Japanese 嚆矢の花道 differs materially from the Chinese bridge and both terms are literary; source-led Vietnamese wording needs dedicated review.
Japanese 追想のトロイメライ contains a culturally loaded loanword/title that may be preserved or interpreted; no stable Vietnamese convention exists.
Japanese 垂れウマ回避 contains a racing term for a fading/slowing horse; lock should wait for a consistent Vietnamese treatment of that term.
Japanese ライバルがいるから！ is a character-voiced sentence title; several natural Vietnamese rhythms are possible and none is canonical.
Japanese アタシが勝つんだから！ encodes explicit character voice/self-reference; do not lock pronoun or catchphrase choices from the Chinese bridge alone.
Japanese 円弧のマエストロ belongs to a マエストロ title family; defer until the project adopts one consistent treatment across related skills.
Japanese 夢叶える末脚 contains the racing term 末脚; canonicalization should wait for a consistent Vietnamese racing-term decision.
Japanese 円舞曲のマエストロ should be reviewed together with 円弧のマエストロ so one マエストロ convention is used consistently.
Japanese 聖夜の天路 is literary and admits several Vietnamese image choices; no stable reviewed mapping exists.
Japanese 聖夜のミラクルラン！ mixes literary wording with a loanword title; project has no reviewed keep-versus-translate convention for ミラクルラン.
Japanese 聖女の挑戦 should be resolved together with 聖女の試練 so 挑戦 and 試練 remain distinctly and naturally translated.
Japanese 聖女の試練 should be resolved together with 聖女の挑戦; locking either alone risks collapsing the distinction between the paired titles.
